title: HS60031: Social Aspects Of Human Settlements
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Rural-urban continuum, dichotomy: Physical and social settings, concept of
little community, peasant society and industrial society, resources â
production system and productions relation; relationship of town and village
today.
Dynamics of rural society: Institutions, leadership, changing power structure
with special reference to Panchayati Raj system.
Urbanization and urban living: trends in urbanization and urban development;
migration, population growth and its impact (social and physical); policies of
urban development.
